findings.evidenceJa: 断腸の思いで承諾する
findings.governingReading: Shirou accepts with a figuratively gut-wrenching sense of reluctance.
findings.explanation: The dictionary-near phrase is stiff non-English and overcasts a reluctant comic concession as formal bereavement.

findings.evidenceJa: 目に見えて不機嫌じゃないか……？
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively asks himself whether Rin is visibly displeased.
findings.explanation: The English removes his questioning uncertainty and states the reading as fact.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしとしては理想的な答えだったわ
findings.governingReading: Rin calls it the ideal answer from her own standpoint.
findings.explanation: The personal frame disappears, turning her preference into an unqualified evaluation.

findings.governingReading: Rin says the answer is a little unsatisfying despite being ideal for her.
findings.explanation: The degree marker is lost and mild residual dissatisfaction becomes categorical dissatisfaction.

findings.governingReading: Rin asks Shirou to accept the magecraft she is about to place on him.
findings.explanation: The technical practice 魔術 is again collapsed into generic magic.

findings.highlight: one of the worst curses around
findings.evidenceJa: 呪いとしては最上級のもの
findings.governingReading: The geas ranks among the highest-grade curses.
findings.explanation: Technical rank or potency becomes a moral and colloquial judgment that it is among the worst.

findings.evidenceJa: あそこまで多様性はない
findings.governingReading: The geas lacks the Command Spell’s breadth or versatility.
findings.explanation: A limited range of applications becomes the much stronger claim that it is not omnipotent.

findings.highlight: Binding you would be the most it can do
findings.evidenceJa: せいぜい金縛りにあうぐらい
findings.governingReading: At most, the curse can inflict a sleep-paralysis-like immobilization.
findings.explanation: The concrete bodily effect is generalized into undefined binding.

findings.governingReading: Rin orders Shirou to remain still for a while.

findings.highlight: Don’t move your body or your Magic Circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路も動かさないこと
findings.governingReading: He must also refrain from activating his Magic Circuits.
findings.explanation: The circuit system is singularized again.

findings.highlight: I’m going to put a geas on you
findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=ギアス char=2]強制をかけるってコト
findings.governingReading: The spell is introduced through layered writing and ruby, and the following chant continues pairing visible German-like text with a Japanese semantic reading.
findings.explanation: The English keeps only the foreign-language surface and discards the Japanese meaning layer throughout the chant.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の魔術にかかっていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou measures how long he was under Rin’s magecraft.
findings.explanation: The second local occurrence again collapses 魔術 into generic magic.

findings.highlight: I don’t know how deep a trance Tohsaka’s magic put me into
findings.evidenceJa: どれほど遠坂の魔術にかかっていたのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders how long he was under Rin’s spell as the lunch break nears its end.
findings.explanation: Duration becomes depth of a newly asserted trance.

findings.highlight: I’ve missed the rest of our break
findings.evidenceJa: 休み時間は終わろうとしていた
findings.governingReading: The break was about to end.
findings.explanation: An imminent endpoint becomes a completed loss of the remaining break.

findings.governingReading: Training will continue for some time beginning today.
findings.explanation: The repeated branch again drops the stated duration.

findings.highlight: you’ll be working overtime every day
findings.evidenceJa: 連日居残ってもらう事になる
findings.governingReading: Rin will have Shirou stay late after school on successive days.
findings.explanation: The repeated branch again replaces a school-day training arrangement with employment language.

findings.evidenceJa: 帰りはかなり遅くなる
findings.governingReading: Rin says Shirou will get home considerably late.
findings.explanation: The repeated branch again omits the degree.

findings.evidenceJa: 家で養生している桜には悪いが
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels guilty toward Sakura because she is recuperating at his house.
findings.explanation: The repeated branch again removes both her recuperation and her presence in the home.
